changed: Importing from The Caller's Box now brings a "square through without hands" in as a circular hey, with who passes first, who passes second, the shoulder and the number of changes, instead of as custom text. Dances you imported earlier keep their custom text.
added: A circular hey can now name the dancers passed second, shown after the first pass (for example "neighbors pass right across, shadows pass left").
Taxonomy v37: `circular_hey.who2`, the group passed second by the other shoulder (default `unspecified`, display-only, not in canonical text). The free-text recognizer reads it back.
changed: The Caller's Box figure dialect decodes `Square through <n> without hands (<pass list>)` as `circular_hey`, with `who2` from the pass list's even cells.
